turns.text: Good afternoon, I am an AI assistant booking on behalf of my client. Would it be possible to reserve a table for two at 17:00 today?
Yes we can seat you at 5. Any allergies or special requests?
Let me just check that and get back to you.
Thank you, there are no allergies or special requests. Could you please let me know the name of the restaurant for the reservation?
Perfect, it's confirmed at Rules restaurant, 5pm today for 2.

Wonderful, thank you ever so much. Just to confirm the booking: a table for two (2 people) at 17:00 (5 pm) today, Sunday, 22 November 2026, at Rules restaurant. We look forward to it. Many thanks again!
